activities.name: Yurt camps at Song Kul
activities.note: the lake sits above 3,000 m, so the nights are bitterly cold even in midsummer; the camps come down for the rest of the year

windows.reason: the most reliable months, with the high passes open, horse riding and trekking running, and the camps fully operating
nomadic families set up on the pastures from around 15 June to 15 September; the edges are quieter but less certain at altitude
